selection_firewall.candidate_origin: MC16 chain_propagation_termination class-gap search; selected because it is an elementary radical-chain propagation family with an independently tabulated high-level barrier benchmark and primary gas-phase kinetics, never because of predicted-versus-observed agreement
selection_firewall.benchmark_method_selection_rule: Use the pre-existing GMTKN55/BH76 W2-F12 reference barrier because it is the benchmark reference value adopted across the BH76 set, not because it is closest to the selected CH3+H2 rate data. DFA and lower-level method variants are not eligible to replace the reference by residual ranking.

candidate_family: methyl-radical hydrogen abstraction from molecular hydrogen
classification_basis: The frozen MC16 ontology explicitly includes chain propagation as well as termination.
This elementary step consumes one radical (CH3) and produces one radical (H), so the radical-carrier count is unchanged, which is the operational chain-propagation pattern.
It is a distinct physical family from the frozen OH + HO2 radical-termination family and from the held methylperoxy self-reaction network.

exact_value_source.authors: Andrew M. Wibowo-Teale, Bang C. Huynh, Trygve Helgaker, David J. Tozer
exact_value_source.title: Classical Reaction Barriers in DFT: An Adiabatic-Connection Perspective
exact_value_source.journal: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation

benchmark_provenance.authors: Lars Goerigk, Andreas Hansen, Christoph Bauer, Stephan Ehrlich, Asim Najibi, Stefan Grimme
benchmark_provenance.title: A look at the density functional theory zoo with the advanced GMTKN55 database for general main group thermochemistry, kinetics and noncovalent interactions
benchmark_provenance.provenance_statement: GMTKN55 updates the BH76 barrier-height reference set to W2-F12 reference values rather than selecting a reaction-specific density functional by agreement with kinetics.

reported_quantity.type: W2-F12 benchmark classical reaction barrier at the GMTKN55/BH76 reference geometry, defined as transition-state total energy (electronic plus nuclear repulsion) minus separated-reactant total energies
reported_quantity.phase_mapping: isolated gas-phase reactants and transition state

observed_comparator.authors: Roger M. Marshall and Gholamreza Shahkar
observed_comparator.title: Rate parameters for CH3 + H2 -> CH4 + H in the temperature range 584-671 K
observed_comparator.journal: Journal of the Chemical Society, Faraday Transactions 1
observed_comparator.type: primary experimental second-order gas-phase rate coefficient
observed_comparator.experimental_design: Azomethane pyrolysis in a large excess of H2 with a data-treatment method designed to determine k2 without assuming a methyl-radical recombination rate constant.

condition_mapping_basis: The W2-F12 quantity is a classical potential-energy barrier and therefore is not assigned the experiment's finite temperature or a solution standard state.
The observed comparator is for the identical forward elementary gas-phase reaction CH3 + H2 -> CH4 + H over 584-671 K and 5-26 Torr.
No solvent, catalyst, isotopologue, or alternate product channel is introduced by the pairing.
The experimental Arrhenius activation term is quarantined as rate-derived and is not substituted for the independent W2-F12 barrier.
independence_basis: The selected barrier is the W2-F12 reference value of the pre-existing GMTKN55/BH76 benchmark set; it is not a reaction-specific functional chosen for closeness to the Marshall-Shahkar kinetics.
The selected observed comparator is a primary experimental rate measurement and is not derived from the W2-F12 barrier.
No predicted-versus-observed residual, chi value, or expected ChemSA agreement was calculated or used to select or promote the candidate.
The family is mechanistically and chemically distinct from FAM-OH-HO2-RADICAL-TERMINATION.
representation_basis: The comparator and benchmark describe the same elementary hydrogen-abstraction step with one saddle-point barrier; no pressure-dependent well network, competing product branch, spin-crossing network, or falloff reduction is required for the registered representation.

preserved_mc16_hold.note: This new propagation-family trail does not relabel, supersede, or promote the methylperoxy self-reaction trail.
